requirementFit.summary: The backend phase provides every contract the frontend phase builds against: users search with a pinned response shape (login = full email, display_name = local-part derived server-side), owner-only chat deletion with the broadcast→delete→close-sockets order and full FK cascade expectations, reactions with a fixed emoji set and unique toggle semantics, replies carried through both REST and WS send paths, reaction summaries riding with messages.

implementationQuality.summary: All eleven round-1 findings closed and re-verified against the actual tree: write-sets now cover the FormContainer retirement and Modal registration (components.ts), the messages service/repository layers required by reply validation and viewer-scoped summaries, the port-literal test file, and the badge stylesheet; the single reactions entry mechanism (always-in-DOM affordance, CSS hover on pointer:fine, no JS long-press), explicit ON DELETE SET NULL, WebSocketMessageContent.reply_to_id, convention-correct test paths, the UNAVAILABLE retry policy for live evidence and the run budget fix.

evidenceQuality.summary: Backend integration tests cover search rules, deletion policy with cascades (files/documents/chunks included), reaction toggle with the test-hub broadcast, reply validation and summaries; frontend component tests cover modals, reactions, replies and the AI badge; the live two-session P2P receipt has an explicit fallback policy (UNAVAILABLE + controller retry, user B ensured by idempotent login-or-register).

residualRisk.summary: The migration is additive; WS stays backward-compatible (unknown event types are ignored, the message contract only gains optional fields); the two workstreams write disjoint trees (backend/** vs src/**) with an explicit A→B dependency; RustFS orphaned bytes on chat deletion accepted as documented local-only behavior.

rounds.summary: Eleven findings (2 HIGH write-set gaps: the FormContainer retirement needs components.ts and the form-container files; reply validation and viewer-scoped summaries need services/messages.py and repositories/messages.py; 2 MEDIUM: chats.test.ts port literals break; the users-search response shape lacked a display_name source; plus LOW: reaction entry mechanism unpinned, ondelete unspecified, deletion ordering, the WS reply field, test paths, evidence fallback policy, budget arithmetic). Architecture confirmed sound: WS backward-compatibility, DB-level cascades, the domain-router seam, hub-keyed broadcast reach.

Every closure verified against the package files and the repository tree; a fresh consistency pass (plan item numbering after insertions, AC/EV binding across all three artifacts, write-set disjointness, budgets, base dev@2003f1d) found no violations; three non-blocking observations recorded (digest recomputation unavailable in the reviewer environment, the register_domain_router seam note for the implementer, revision numbering norm).
